description.en-US: The pricelist this item belongs to. Immutable: moving an item between lists would change what two lists charge at once, and any order priced under the one it left would keep a price that list can no longer justify.

What is being priced. The variant, not the template: the variant is the transactable unit, and two variants of one template can legitimately cost different amounts. A plain ulid, since the product belongs to Inventory.

The unit the price is PER. Required, because a price without its unit is not a price: 50,000 per case and 50,000 per bottle are different offers. A line priced in another unit is converted through Essential rather than assumed compatible.

The price per unit of uom_id. Zero is permitted and meaningful: a giveaway line still needs a price to be recorded at, and forbidding zero would push those through a discount path where they do not belong.

The smallest quantity this price applies from, expressed in uom_id. Quantity breaks are rows rather than a nested structure, so a list can hold 1-at-full-price and 10-at-a-discount as two ordinary items. Required with a default of zero rather than nullable: the uniqueness key includes it, and a NULL in a unique key would let the same break be written twice (a NULL never equals a NULL).
